title: Python: airtime tracking in duty cycle
description: Airtime tracking feeds duty cycle. AC: Actual airtime deducted from duty cycle budget after TX.
close_reason: Added airtime_us tracking to NodeMetrics. After each TX, actual airtime (tx.end_time_us - tx.start_time_us) is deducted from the duty cycle budget via node.metrics.record_tx(airtime_us=airtime_us). NodeMetrics.to_dict() now includes airtime_us for duty cycle accounting.
